name: Lost Legacy
summary: A Love Letter-style deduction game where players play cards for effects to eliminate others or find the hidden Lost Legacy card.
rules_text: Choose a 16-card set and shuffle into a deck. Deal one hidden card to each player as their hand and one hidden card to the ruins. Players take turns clockwise. On your turn draw the top card of the deck so you have two, then play one face up in front of you and resolve its effect as fully as possible: e.g., look at hands, swap cards, force discards, eliminate players. Discarded cards stay face up. If eliminated, discard your hand face up; if it was the Lost Legacy, shuffle it back into the deck. If only one player remains, they win. If the deck becomes empty, enter the Investigation Phase. Players investigate in order of Investigation Speed number on their remaining hand card, lowest first. Ties and X cannot investigate. On your turn choose any hand or the ruins to reveal. If you reveal the Lost Legacy, you win. If no one reveals it, all lose.
rating_reason: 16-card deduction game like Love Letter, hidden hands
reasons: capability: conditional_subsequence: the step list is flat: a whole BLOCK of steps cannot be chosen instead of another block. This is NOT a limit on conditional scoring or conditional updates: a single step can carry a `when` condition and a single operation an `if`, both arithmetic, so 'the poisoner scores if the choices match, otherwise the chooser' is fine
